text.description_html:
Acorn IHBBP, 20" Royal Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge

The 20" Iron Art Royal Tip Dummy Strap Hinges can be used with butt hinges. It is made out of forged iron using the traditional techniques of the hammer and anvil. Decorative straps like this one, give an old world charm to any home door, gate, shutter, or garage door without the need of installing working hinges or replacing existing hardware. Made famous by the French monarch Louis VII, the Fleur-de-lis shape tip represents the strength and power. The black iron finish is guaranteed not to rust. When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, this Acorn made 20" Hand Forged Dummy Strap Royal Tip Hinge can really make your home stand out.

Also Available Matching: 14" Royal Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications of the Royal Tip Dummy Strap Hinges:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 20"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
